A message from inside Iran; 

A father got online for a few minutes after 84 days of internet blackout.

 He was just crying, saying he can't feed his family anymore.
 "Everyone that I know here, has lost their job, families can't pay rent, we are broken."

 #DigitalBlackoutIran
